course_name: 進階英文閱讀與聽講練習
outline: 教導學生閱讀囊括全球議題的文章，並藉由文章的內容作技巧的訓練，字彙的建構，語言的解析，及思維的啟發。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
schedule:
Week 1: Orientation
Week 2: Pre-Test & Discussions
Week 3-8: Reading global trends and issues / TOEIC preparation
Week 9: Midterm
Week 10-17: Reading general topics / TOEIC preparation
Week 18 Final Exam
assessment:
Grading Policy
Attendance 30% (10% deduction penalty for each absence)
In-class practice & participation  15%
In-class quizzes (TOEIC preparation) 15%
Midterm and Final 30%
Learning Portfolio 10%
